notes: Generated routing and basic-output starter. Curate realistic prompts and example-backed task scenarios before treating it as behavior evidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build developmental sales role-play scenarios with facilitator-only briefs, behaviorally anchored feedback, and run protocols.
I need help with practice drills in discovery, demos, objections, negotiation, or executive conversations.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable roleplay scenario and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Produces Scenario: one focused scenario by default, or a justified progression that changes one variable at a time; Participant Brief: context, objective, constraints, and success criteria.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
